policy: A HIGH or CRITICAL finding that has a fix blocks the build. A finding may be accepted here for a short time (at most 45 days ahead) with a reason; an expired entry blocks again, so renew one deliberately or take the fix by bumping the pinned base image in Containerfile.base.

exceptions.reason: Perl is in the slim base image only because dpkg depends on it; the container runs node and nothing invokes perl. The fixed package (5.36.0-7+deb12u4) is not yet in the pinned node base image; take it by bumping the digest when the node image is rebuilt.
